task.goal: Close the entire Storybook autonomy upgrade on the current architecture with no paid API.
requirements: Self-update all runtime-control-manifest files from origin/main, including Storybook evidence script and dependency config.
Run the real Storybook pipeline: build-storybook -> Vitest Storybook browser tests -> Playwright desktop/mobile evidence.

Treat evidence capture infrastructure separately from design quality. A valid capture with failing DESIGN_DISTINCT or WESTSIDE_FIT is an observation for the next autonomous hypothesis, not an infrastructure failure.
Confirm FUNCTION and A11Y from the authoritative Storybook Vitest run; visual capture owns render/stability/responsive/design-fit observations.
On a failed design gate, checkpoint the observation, choose a materially different information-gaining design hypothesis, and continue autonomously rather than waiting for ChatGPT.
Prove pending peer work remains non-blocking while this runs.
Run loop contract acceptance and the Storybook autonomy-check.

Return canonical PASS only when the infrastructure pipeline is fully functional, at least three autonomous iterations are evidenced, and restart/self-update persistence is evidenced. Design-reference-library parent acceptance may remain open if its separate 40-reference/6-family/3-direction product goal is not yet met.
